as_told.title: Mario's account of starting Lazar's car for fear of a bomb

plain: Around 1989 in Las Vegas, Bob Lazar says his locked car kept being found open, so often that he and a friend feared someone had planted a bomb in it. Lazar is a man who says he worked on alien craft for the US government. He tells it himself: "we would lock it and test the door and because it had happened before and go, 'All right, it's locked.'" He says the car was open again later anyway. The friend was Mario Woods. A researcher named Luigi Vendittelli passes on what Woods told him. Woods said he was with Lazar all the time and "we were scared that something was going to blow up." Woods said he was going through such hard times that he didn't care. He told Lazar to stay back and started the car himself. The story is told as a sign that someone was watching and pressuring Lazar after he spoke out.
